grass.description: Meadow grass, the main ground of the open world. Repeats every 2 m.

grass_lush.description: Deeper green grass with clover and tiny flowers, for valleys and gardens.

dirt.description: Bare soil for fields edges, digging spots and forest paths.

path.description: Packed earth road, worn smooth by travellers.

sand.description: Soft beach and riverbank sand with gentle wind ripples.

mud.description: Wet mud by rivers and swamps, shiny in the dips.

farmland.description: Tilled farm soil in rows, for the farm plots.

forest_floor.description: Shady woodland floor with fallen leaves, needles and moss.

snow.description: Fresh snow for mountain tops, soft and slightly blue in the shade.

rock.description: Everyday grey rock for boulders, cliffs and mining rocks.

rock_mossy.description: Rock with moss growing on its upper faces, for forests and old ruins.

slate.description: Dark layered slate for mountain cliffs and roof stone.

sandstone.description: Warm banded sandstone for desert cliffs and city foundations.

cobblestone.description: Rounded cobbles for Emberhold's streets and market square.

flagstone.description: Big flat paving slabs for halls, plazas and the Emberhall floor.

stone_brick.description: Cut stone blocks for castle walls, the Emberhall and city gates.

wood_pine.description: Pine wood grain for tool handles, bows, staffs and furniture.

wood_oak.description: Oak wood grain for tool handles, bows, staffs and furniture.

wood_birch.description: Birch wood grain for tool handles, bows, staffs and furniture.

wood_maple.description: Maple wood grain for tool handles, bows, staffs and furniture.

wood_yew.description: Yew wood grain for tool handles, bows, staffs and furniture.

wood_ironwood.description: Ironwood wood grain for tool handles, bows, staffs and furniture.

wood_elderwood.description: Elderwood wood grain for tool handles, bows, staffs and furniture.

planks.description: Oak floorboards and wall planks for houses, docks and the farm.

bark_pine.description: Deep-grooved pine bark for pine trees.

bark_oak.description: Chunky oak bark for oak and maple trees.

bark_birch.description: White birch bark with dark marks for birch trees.

metal_bronze.description: Brushed bronze for tool heads, weapons, armor and jewellery.

metal_iron.description: Brushed iron for tool heads, weapons, armor and jewellery.

metal_steel.description: Brushed steel for tool heads, weapons, armor and jewellery.

metal_mithril.description: Brushed mithril for tool heads, weapons, armor and jewellery.

metal_copper.description: Brushed copper for tool heads, weapons, armor and jewellery.

metal_silver.description: Brushed silver for tool heads, weapons, armor and jewellery.

metal_gold.description: Brushed gold for tool heads, weapons, armor and jewellery.

metal_platinum.description: Brushed platinum for tool heads, weapons, armor and jewellery.

metal_iridium.description: Brushed iridium for tool heads, weapons, armor and jewellery.

metal_embersteel.description: Brushed embersteel for tool heads, weapons, armor and jewellery.

metal_rusty_iron.description: Old iron with soft rust, for gates, chains and abandoned mines.

water.description: Normal map for lakes, rivers and the sea. Colour comes from the water shader's depth tint.

foam.description: Soft white foam for shorelines, waterfalls and boat wakes. Use as a mask.

leaves_broad.description: Broadleaf card (oak, maple, birch canopies). Alpha cut-out.

leaves_autumn.description: Autumn leaf card for maple trees and fall areas. Alpha cut-out.

pine_needles.description: Pine and yew needle card. Alpha cut-out.

grass_blades.description: Grass tuft card for 3D grass you walk through. Alpha cut-out.

moss.description: Soft cushion moss for rocks, roofs and tree roots.

linen.description: Plain undyed linen for shirts, robes, sacks and banners.

wool_red.description: Red dyed wool for cloaks and Emberguard banners.

wool_blue.description: Blue dyed wool for clothes and mage robes.

wool_green.description: Green dyed wool for rangers' and farmers' clothes.

burlap.description: Rough sacking for grain sacks, targets and the training dummies.

leather.description: Tanned leather for armor, belts, boots, bags and book covers.

fur.description: Short animal fur for pelts, wolves, boars and fur trims.

feathers.description: Soft overlapping feathers for chickens, birds and arrow fletching.

thatch.description: Straw thatch for farmhouse and village roofs.

roof_tiles.description: Rounded clay roof tiles for Emberhold's houses.

plaster.description: Warm whitewashed plaster for house walls.

brick.description: Red brick for chimneys, forges and the smithy.

embers.description: Glowing embers and coals for forges, campfires and the Flame. Emission on the hot cracks.

ice.description: Clear blue ice for frost spells, frozen lakes and the cold north.

crystal.description: Arcane crystal for gems, mana stones and the Emberhall's restricted section.

ore_veins.description: Rock with bright metal veins, a base the scenery thread can tint per ore (copper, iron, gold, mithril...).
